newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks ease as trade dwindles.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks ease as trade dwindles.

text.p: Croatian stocks took a dive to close mostly lower on Thursday in dwindling trade.
* Eight of nine active issues fell and one was flat.
* Volume 4,488 shares, turnover 2.5 million kuna. For full results see page ZAGSTOCK.
* Biggest decliner, electric cables maker Elka, shed 55 kuna or 17.3 percent from last week to end at 215 kuna. It sold 524 shares.
* Most active fully-listed Zagrebacka Banka fell 20 kuna to 1,000 with 1,324 units traded.
* Pliva down 50 kuna to 13,450 on volume of 21 shares.
* Hotelier Jadranturist was the only stock to hold its ground at 290 kuna on a volume of 631 shares. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
